identification: About 29 boxed 1:43 diecast cars: 5 Solido 'Modeles reduits - Modeles precis' black-box Age d'Or (Bugatti 57 Atlantic blue, a mint-green 1930s cabriolet, three black/grey 1930s saloons/cabriolets); 6 Solido 'Les Modeles Prestigieux 1925/1940' maroon boxes (red/white-roof roadster, red/black tourer with whitewalls, yellow/black town car, blue/white cabriolet, red cabriolet, red/black car); 2 Solido 1970s-80s blue/orange window boxes (green and white small Renault/Simca hatches); 1 Solido blue box (red open sports car with race number, Solido 4500-type series); 1 Solido Gam 2 (light blue Peugeot/Renault saloon); 2 Matchbox 'Dinky Collection' (light blue 1950s Buick Skylark-type convertibles, 1990s); 1 Maisto 1:43 (red sports car, clamshell pack); 10 Rastar 1:43 modern licensed cars (3 BMW i8, 4 Mercedes SLS AMG, Jeep, Lamborghini, white BMW); 1 partwork model on plinth (cream Oldsmobile Toronado type). Boxes with light wear. Armitage estimate $50-70, current bid $25.
